No PYQ exists. The ICAI May 2020 examination cycle was cancelled because of COVID-19 and merged into the November 2020 cycle, so ICAI published neither a question paper nor Suggested Answers. Confirmed by absence from both official ICAI listings: https://www.icai.org/post.html?post_id=14759 (Paper 7 question papers, which runs May 2018 -> November 2023 with no May 2020 entry) and the Paper 7 Suggested Answers listings. RTP/MTP for May 2020 do exist and are covered by the RTP/MTP slices, not here.
